system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 31. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (20 seconds, code score 0.91) ---
[b00] CATHERINE (enraged scream): "Enough!"
[b01] SFX: Hiss of scorched parchment and curling white smoke rising as paper blackens under extreme heat.
[b02] CATHERINE (hateful, malicious): "This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother."
[b03] ACTION: Tears spill rapidly down Juliana's cheeks as she reaches forward in vain, restrained by her heavy iron chains.
[b04] JULIANA (desperate, weeping): "[gasping] Give it back!"
[b05] CATHERINE (gloating, sadistic): "There. Finally. Something still hurts you."
[b06] JULIANA (screaming, agonized): "No!"
[b07] CATHERINE (vicious, final): "One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash."

--- WINDOW 1 (49 seconds, code score 0.89) ---
[b00] CATHERINE (mocking, hysterical laugh): "[laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you."
[b01] JULIANA (firm, piercing): "To a place where I can still look you in the eyes."
[b02] CATHERINE (incredulous, offended): "You think love makes you better than me?"
[b03] JULIANA (calm, cutting): "No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me."
[b04] CATHERINE (incensed, boastful): "I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?"
[b05] JULIANA (quiet, powerful): "Knowledge. Love. And people who need me."
[b06] CATHERINE (sneering, derisive): "[scoffs] Peasants? People?"
[b07] CATHERINE (arrogant, elitist): "That is why you were born in the wrong world. Women like me are meant to be admired. Women like you are meant to serve."
[b08] JULIANA (piercing, provocative): "Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?"
[b09] ACTION: Catherine's smug expression freezes, her eyes widening in momentary shock and fury as the blow lands squarely.
[b10] JULIANA (accusatory, commanding): "If you were truly powerful, Catherine, you wouldn't need me to bow."
[b11] CATHERINE (enraged scream): "Enough!"

--- WINDOW 2 (40 seconds, code score 0.83) ---
[b00] CATHERINE (mocking, venomous): "The great Lady Juliana Ashcroft."
[b01] CATHERINE (taunting): "Chained in a dungeon like a common criminal."
[b02] JULIANA (defiant, steady): "You seem very pleased."
[b03] CATHERINE (smug, chilling): "I am."
[b04] CATHERINE (whispering, sinister): "Because this is what you were always meant to be."
[b05] CATHERINE (scornful): "Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name."
[b06] CATHERINE (amused, spiteful): "[chuckles] And still you became a disgrace."
[b07] JULIANA (fierce, unbroken): "I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel."
[b08] CATHERINE (cold, bitter): "No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar."
[b09] CATHERINE (gloating): "Do you remember?"
[b10] ACTION: Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.

--- WINDOW 3 (42 seconds, code score 0.81) ---
[b00] CATHERINE (gloating): "Do you remember?"
[b01] ACTION: Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.
[b02] CATHERINE (viciously delighted): "Everyone saw you. Everyone watched him chose Clarisse."
[b03] SFX: Faint sizzling and hissing as ambient moisture touches the scalding iron tip.
[b04] CATHERINE (quietly venomous): "And everyone watched you walk away alone."
[b05] JULIANA (proud, measured): "Gerald chose money."
[b06] JULIANA (resolute): "Clarissa chose a coward."
[b07] JULIANA (unyielding): "I chose myself."
[b08] CATHERINE (disgusted): "You chose a beggar."
[b09] JULIANA (fierce, proud): "I chose a man."
[b10] CATHERINE (contemptuous): "A scarred nobody."
[b11] JULIANA (resolute, dignified): "A man with more honor than the people sitting above this dungeon."
[b12] CATHERINE (incredulous, mocking): "You call that marriage?"
[b13] JULIANA (pure, sincere): "I call it love."
[b14] CATHERINE (mocking, hysterical laugh): "[laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you."
[b15] JULIANA (firm, piercing): "To a place where I can still look you in the eyes."

Pick the single best promo.
